purpose: Perform the entire even-Fourier sum inside each original-variable occurrence group symbolically, replacing 2^(q-n) character choices by one binary exterior block A_i+B_i per original variable. This is an exact algebraic compression of the parity projection, not yet a polynomial-time evaluator of the resulting top exterior coefficient.

setup.occurrence_rank1_matrix: Use the v1.0 augmented determinant N(t)=[[M0,U],[-T V^T,I+T]], with one sign t_o in {+1,-1} per literal occurrence o.
setup.fixed_rows: Let R_fixed be the wedge of the top rows [M0,U] in their canonical order.
setup.bottom_row_split: For occurrence o, the bottom row is r_o(t_o)=a_o+t_o b_o, where a_o=(0,e_o) and b_o=(-v_o^T,e_o).
setup.groups: For original variable i let O_i be its ordered set of occurrence indices and d_i=|O_i|. Reorder bottom rows once so occurrence rows are grouped by original variable; record the computable permutation sign sigma(F).
setup.group_blades: A_i = wedge_{o in O_i} a_o and B_i = wedge_{o in O_i} b_o, using the frozen within-group occurrence order.

local_character_identity.name: EVEN_SIGN_GROUP_PROJECTOR
local_character_identity.statement: For every nonempty occurrence group O of size d, sum over sign vectors t in {+1,-1}^O with product_o t_o=1 of wedge_{o in O}(a_o+t_o b_o) equals 2^(d-1)(A_O+B_O).
proof: Expand the wedge product by the subset S of positions choosing b_o instead of a_o.
The coefficient of the S-term is sum_{product t=1} product_{o in S} t_o.
The even-sign subgroup has exactly two trivial characters on subset labels: S=empty and S=O. Hence the character sum is 2^(d-1) for S=empty or S=O and is 0 for every proper nonempty S.
The two surviving terms are precisely A_O and B_O.

global_theorem.name: SAT_COUNT_AS_ONE_EXTERIOR_BINARY_BLOCK_COEFFICIENT
global_theorem.statement: Let n be the number of nonempty original-variable groups and q the number of literal occurrences. Then #SAT(F)=sigma(F)*[TOP](R_fixed wedge product_i(A_i+B_i)), where [TOP] is the coefficient of the canonical top exterior basis after the bottom-row grouping permutation.
proof: The v1.0 Fourier identity gives #SAT(F)=2^(n-q) sum_{s in E} det N((-1)^s), where E imposes even parity independently inside every O_i.
After the one fixed bottom-row permutation, determinant is the top exterior coefficient of R_fixed wedge product_i product_{o in O_i}(a_o+t_o b_o), multiplied by sigma(F).
The sign choices factor by variable group. Apply EVEN_SIGN_GROUP_PROJECTOR independently to every group.
The product of local factors is product_i 2^(d_i-1)=2^(sum_i d_i-n)=2^(q-n), which cancels the Fourier prefactor 2^(n-q) exactly.
The remaining object is one product of n binary exterior blocks A_i+B_i.

bounded_occurrence_specialization.statement: After the standard bounded-occurrence normalization used by the E8 rank-3-switch line, d_i<=3. Therefore every live factor A_i+B_i is a sum of two decomposable blades of degree at most three.
bounded_occurrence_specialization.degree2: A_i+B_i is a 2-form that is a sum of two decomposable 2-blades.
bounded_occurrence_specialization.degree3: A_i+B_i is a 3-form that is a sum of two decomposable 3-blades; this is the exterior-algebra image of the 2-vs-1 Boolean switch.

positive: The exponential even-character sum is eliminated symbolically with no approximation and no loss of witness information at the identity level.
No group algebra of size 2^(q-n) is materialized.
The resulting exterior expression has polynomial description size: two decomposable blades per original variable plus the fixed top-row wedge.
algorithmic_value.missing: A deterministic polynomial-time exact algorithm for the top coefficient of this source-aligned product of binary blades. Expanding the n binary factors is 2^n and is forbidden.
algorithmic_value.warning: Polynomial description size of an exterior circuit is not the same as polynomial evaluability of its top coefficient; generic higher-order Pfaffian/hyperpfaffian coefficient extraction is not assumed tractable.

next_target.name: E8_SOURCE_ALIGNED_BINARY_BLADE_TOP_COEFFICIENT_V2_6
next_target.directive: Exploit the special occurrence-rank1 vectors a_o=(0,e_o), b_o=(-v_o^T,e_o), clause-block structure of R_fixed, and degree<=3 groups. Seek a polynomial determinant/Pfaffian/augmentation identity for the top coefficient. Immediately reject any proposal that merely re-expands the 2^n coherent A_i/B_i choices, invokes a generic hyperpfaffian oracle, or stores an exponential Grassmann basis.
success_obligations: deterministic polynomial construction and arithmetic/bit complexity
exact zero/nonzero decision equivalent to SAT
polynomial witness reconstruction via self-reduction or direct lifting
no hidden exponential basis, character sum, branch tree, field extension, or oracle

scientific_ceiling.NEW_POSITIVE_MECHANISM: Exact cancellation of all proper mixed occurrence states inside every variable group, leaving exactly the two coherent exterior blades A_i and B_i.
